templates.name: Apple CMS V10 JSON

detection.match: response is JSON and has a 'list' key

extraction.detail: ac=detail&ids={id} -> vod_play_from/vod_play_url; split lines by '$$$', episodes by '#', each 'name$url'
extraction.stream: vod_play_url is usually a direct m3u8/mp4; return as-is with parse=0 when direct, else follow the site player page

templates.note: Probe this first for any unknown site: cheapest and most reliable CMS signal.

templates.name: YSTV shared TVBox API

detection.match: response is JSON with a nav list; api host is often a different domain from the site (e.g. tv506.ystv.top, api3.bwkhawkdv.cc)

templates.note: Biggest merge: 17 sites share one backend. The api host is the fingerprint, not the site domain.

templates.name: MacCMS HTML routes

detection.match: homepage HTML contains links matching /vod/detail/, /vod/play/, /vod/type/, /vod/search/ or /voddetail/, /vodplay/, /vodtype/, /vodsearch/ or /index.php/vod/

extraction.list: /vod/type/id/{id}-{page}.html or /vodtype/{id}-{page}/, parse video cards (title, cover, link)
extraction.detail: /vod/detail/id/{id}.html or /voddetail/{id}/, parse title/cover/desc and play lines /vod/play/id/{id}-1-{ep}.html
extraction.stream: from the play page extract the video URL (JS var or iframe src); direct m3u8/mp4 when present

templates.note: Covers both /vod/ and /index.php/vod/ route styles and the /voddetail/ short style.

templates.name: WordPress wp-json

detection.match: response is JSON describing wp types/posts

extraction.stream: from post content extract the video URL or iframe src

templates.note: 69vj verified; the other three are drafts but share the same wp-json shape.

templates.name: Next.js SSR

detection.page_feature: Next.js static chunks and SSR data

extraction.list: category pages, parse from __NEXT_DATA__ JSON or HTML cards
extraction.detail: detail page SSR data; the real cover is the vodPic field in SSR data
extraction.search: search page with a desktop UA
extraction.stream: play address kept as-is, do not rewrite to /vodplay-*.html; take it from SSR data

templates.note: No pure Next.js site in the collected set is verified yet; tool probe only.

templates.name: Generic HTML sniffing (fallback)

detection.match: always applies when no other template matches

extraction.categories: nav links clustered by path pattern; numeric IDs and nav text both tried
extraction.list: link-path clustering to find detail pages; pagination candidates rotated until a non-empty page is found
extraction.detail: multi-template episode extraction; title/cover/desc from common selectors
extraction.search: multi-candidate search URLs, first non-empty wins
extraction.stream: from the play/detail page extract the first playable URL (m3u8/mp4/iframe); direct links returned with parse=0

templates.note: Fallback for all custom HTML sites. Per-site verification is still needed after generation.

templates.name: Caoliu/ThePorny AES API

detection.match: site uses this api host: v2.* hosts (8 hosts rotate)

extraction.stream: POST v2.* /js, header 'Bearer undefined' (literal), response AES-256 decrypted; signed URL valid about 6800s, fetch fresh each time; rotate hosts on blocked 403

templates.note: caoliu in core, 8/8 tests. Anonymous full-length stream; the 120s preview limit is only in the site player.
